statements.__comment__: DEPRECATED: temporary backward-compatibility migration. Remove in v1.0.0. Earlier versions scoped LangSmithDeployment, LangSmithSecret, LangSmithResourceTag and LangSmithMcpServer to the organization and linked them to their workspace with CONTAINS. The workspace is now their sub-resource. Backfill the RESOURCE edge from the workspace, so nodes in a workspace that can't be read this run stay reachable by its cleanup. Scoped by $ORG_ID. Idempotent (MERGE).
statements.query: MATCH (:LangSmithOrganization {id: $ORG_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(w:LangSmithWorkspace)-[:CONTAINS]->(n) WHERE n:LangSmithDeployment OR n:LangSmithSecret OR n:LangSmithResourceTag OR n:LangSmithMcpServer MERGE (w)-[r:RESOURCE]->(n) ON CREATE SET r.firstseen = timestamp(), r.lastupdated = n.lastupdated

statements.__comment__: DEPRECATED: temporary backward-compatibility migration. Remove in v1.0.0. Earlier versions scoped LangSmithWorkspaceMembership to the organization and linked it to its workspace with IN_WORKSPACE. Backfill the RESOURCE edge from the workspace. Scoped by $ORG_ID. Idempotent (MERGE).
statements.query: MATCH (:LangSmithOrganization {id: $ORG_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(w:LangSmithWorkspace)<-[:IN_WORKSPACE]-(m:LangSmithWorkspaceMembership) MERGE (w)-[r:RESOURCE]->(m) ON CREATE SET r.firstseen = timestamp(), r.lastupdated = m.lastupdated

statements.__comment__: DEPRECATED: temporary backward-compatibility migration. Remove in v1.0.0. Remove the workspace CONTAINS edges that RESOURCE replaces. LangSmithOAuthClient is included because OAuth clients are registered against the organization, not a workspace. LangSmithApiKey keeps its CONTAINS edges. Scoped by $ORG_ID.
statements.query: MATCH (:LangSmithOrganization {id: $ORG_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(:LangSmithWorkspace)-[c:CONTAINS]->(n) WHERE n:LangSmithDeployment OR n:LangSmithSecret OR n:LangSmithResourceTag OR n:LangSmithMcpServer OR n:LangSmithOAuthClient DELETE c

statements.__comment__: DEPRECATED: temporary backward-compatibility migration. Remove in v1.0.0. Remove the IN_WORKSPACE edges that RESOURCE replaces. Scoped by $ORG_ID.

DEPRECATED: temporary backward-compatibility migration. Remove in v1.0.0. Remove the organization RESOURCE edges from nodes that now hang off a workspace. Only nodes that already have their workspace RESOURCE edge lose the organization edge, so no node is left unreachable. Scoped by $ORG_ID.
statements.query: MATCH (:LangSmithOrganization {id: $ORG_ID})-[r:RESOURCE]->(n) WHERE (n:LangSmithDeployment OR n:LangSmithSecret OR n:LangSmithResourceTag OR n:LangSmithMcpServer OR n:LangSmithWorkspaceMembership) AND EXISTS { MATCH (n)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:LangSmithWorkspace) } DELETE r
